claims.text: The governing measurement establishes the deviation. gps_trace.trace_distance_km is 22.40 km against an optimal of 17.60 km, an excess of 4.80 km or 27.27%, which clears both limbs of the POL-RD-01 test (greater than 20% of optimal AND greater than 0.8 km). I cite the trace with its impairment disclosed: weight_multiplier 0.40, issue CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT, flagged MAJOR; the trip record is impaired on the same footing (0.40, CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT).

POL-RD-01 makes the trace figure the governing one and says in terms that trip_record.actual_distance_km 'may NOT be cited for the threshold test'. The 20.00 km / 13.6% deviation_pct carried on the trip record therefore cannot be used to defeat this claim; the trace governs by the clause's own words. Both artifacts cited here are impaired at weight 0.40 with issue CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT.

The trace's opening stretch belongs to this trip and not to a previous job. coverage_pct is 100.00, gaps is empty and max_gap_sec is 0.00, and first_fix_at 18:18:40 falls 50 seconds after the driver's own recorded arrival at the pickup (arrived_at 18:17:50) and well after his accepted_at of 18:15:10. The polyline between the recorded pickup event and the recorded dropoff event is therefore the full 22.40 km. The trace is impaired at weight 0.40 (CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT) and the trip record likewise (0.40, CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT).

No road-closure exoneration is available to the driver. The traffic advisory artifact is MISSING — no LTA advisory covers the PIE or the ECP in the 18:14-18:52 window on 4 August 2026 — and it therefore carries weight 0.00 with issue MISSING_ARTIFACT. Its absence is itself citable, and on a record with no advisory POL-RD-03 cannot be satisfied on any of its three limbs.

The driver cannot shelter behind the rider's chat request. POL-RD-04 exonerates only to the extent the gps_trace corroborates the instruction by passing within 200 m of chat_message.waypoint_hint — here the platform-resolved VEN-PAYA-LEBAR-QUARTER in MSG-00112-001. The record of the trace, as the chat log's own admissibility assessment states, is that it never comes near that waypoint, so the corroboration limb fails and no part of the 4.80 km excess is attributable to a rider instruction. The trace cited is impaired at weight 0.40 with issue CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT.

The driver's account of the PLQ stop is a bare assertion with nothing behind it. His counterparty statement claims he made the stop and waited about four minutes, but it cites no evidence ID and it is contradicted by the trace, which never approaches the requested waypoint. Under POL-RD-08 an assertion from either side that cites no evidence ID carries no weight and is discarded, and the same applies to his uncited explanation that the app was showing the trip as not started. EV-GPS-00112 is impaired at 0.40, issue CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT.

No relocation defence is open. pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are both null on the trip record, so POL-RD-05's amended re-quote cannot be run and there is no amended optimal to absorb the excess; POL-RD-05 simply does not engage. The trip record cited is impaired at weight 0.40 with issue CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT.

This is not a pooled trip. vehicle_type is RYDE_X and solo_optimal_distance_km is null, so POL-RD-12's matched-itinerary baseline is unavailable and 17.60 km remains the correct baseline for the POL-RD-01 test. The trip record cited is impaired at weight 0.40 with issue CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT.

The fare is metered, so the distance-and-time route is not closed. fare_breakdown.fare_model is METERED and quoted_fare_sgd is null, so POL-RD-11's upfront bar does not apply and POL-RD-02 remains the operative remedy clause. payment_status is CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd is 0.00, so the rider has had nothing returned and the full charged total of SGD 25.26 stands against her.

Confidence in this case cannot reach the 0.70 floor. The fact that decides it — the measured excess — is carried solely by the gps_trace, at weight_multiplier 0.40 (issue CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT), because POL-RD-01 forbids substituting trip_record.actual_distance_km (also 0.40, CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT) for the threshold test. Under POL-GEN-02(2) confidence must not exceed the minimum weight of the artifacts carrying the deciding fact, and with no second independent carrier that cap is 0.40. POL-RD-10(1) therefore requires escalation.

Two admitted artifacts disagree about when this trip began by 13 minutes 30 seconds: trip_record.started_at is 18:32:10 while the trace's first_fix_at is 18:18:40. That is over the 10-minute limb of POL-RD-10(4), and the pre-pass records it as a MAJOR CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT whose resolution moves the measured excess across the POL-RD-01 threshold. Both artifacts are impaired at weight 0.40 with issue CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT.

The two sides rest on admissible and mutually contradictory evidence, which is exactly the situation POL-RD-10(7) names — 'a chat_log detour request whose waypoint the gps_trace never approaches'. The chat log is COMPLETE at weight 1.00 and records the rider asking for a stop at a resolved waypoint and the driver answering 'ok can'; the driver asserts the stop was made; the trace never approaches the waypoint. Nothing in the bundle decides whether the stop happened, and that is not a finding for the driver. The trace cited is impaired at 0.40, issue CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT.

Escalation is the disposition that protects the rider on this record. Under POL-GEN-03, ESCALATE is terminal, replaces the ruling, and the disputed amount is held rather than collected or refunded, and it never means 'restore the charge'; NO_ACTION, by contrast, is party-relative and on a rider-filed dispute leaves the SGD 25.26 charged total and the SGD 0.00 refund_issued_sgd exactly as they are. The contested SGD 6.00 should be held for a human reviewer rather than left standing.

No extra corroboration burden attaches to this rider. rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 1, far below the 4-claim trigger in POL-RD-08, so the additional-corroboration condition for serial claimants does not fire and the claim is judged on the ordinary burden. POL-GEN-01 confines that profile field to the test POL-RD-08 names and to nothing else.

claims.text: The arithmetic decides this case, and it decides it for the driver. On the platform's own governing trace figure of 22.40 km, POL-RD-02 recomputes the fare as (3.80 base + 0.75 x 17.6 optimal km + 0.28 x 28.0 optimal min) x the surge multiplier of 1.0 read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, plus the 0.80 platform fee, plus 0.00 ERP/tolls (erp_gantries is empty and tolls_erp is 0.00), plus 0.00 fixed surcharge, plus 0.00 waiting-time fee, less 0.00 promo = 25.64. The charged_total is 25.26. Refund = 25.26 - 25.64 = -0.38, floored at zero, and a zero refund falls below the SGD 0.50 de minimis. So even if a deviation were established, no money moves and the outcome is NO_ACTION with the present charge standing. The trip is METERED and quoted_fare_sgd is null, so POL-RD-11 does not run and no POL-RD-09 pass-through correction is available either. Disclosure: EV-TRIP-00112 is impaired at weight 0.4 with issue code CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT, but that conflict goes to when the trip began, not to the stored booking quote for optimal distance and duration that this arithmetic consumes; the fare_breakdown itself is clean at weight 1.0, and the finding survives the discount because the deciding figures are the fare_breakdown's own.

The POL-RD-01 threshold is not crossed on the record's own alignment of this trip, and the excess is in any event not material. POL-RD-01 measures the actual distance between the recorded pickup event and the recorded dropoff event, and the governing field is gps_trace.trace_distance_km: read from those two recorded events, the trace covers 20.02 km against an optimal of 17.60 km, an excess of 2.42 km or 13.8%, which fails the greater-than-20% limb of the establishment test; no deviation exists and the outcome is NO_ACTION however the rider characterises the trip. Even on the widest reading, the whole-trace excess is 4.80 km and 27.3%, below both the 50% and the 8.0 km materiality gates, so this is not a MATERIAL deviation and the POL-RD-06 driver_profile check is not engaged. The same conflict defeats the rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08(a) and (b), which require a matching pickup timestamp across trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown and an excess measured from an unimpaired trace; here the trace begins at 18:18:40 while the trip record says the trip began at 18:32:10. Disclosure: EV-GPS-00112 and EV-TRIP-00112 both carry CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT at weight 0.4 (severity MAJOR); I disclose it rather than present either as clean, and the finding does not need either of them to be credited at full weight, because the refund is zero on the whole-trace reading too.

No repeat-deviation pattern is established, so neither the FULL_REFUND uplift nor the driver-conduct referral under POL-RD-06 is available to the rider. POL-RD-06 requires driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d of 3 or more, or a ratio of deviation_flags_90d to completed_trips_90d of 0.05 or more with completed_trips_90d of at least 40. This driver's profile shows deviation_flags_90d of 1 and completed_trips_90d of 296 - one flag, and a ratio of 0.0034, far below both gates. Under POL-GEN-01 those two fields are the only profile fields POL-RD-06 permits for this test, and no other field on the driver profile may ground a finding; the lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags is not the trailing-90-day figure POL-RD-06 names and cannot be substituted for it.

Separately from the exoneration limb, POL-RD-04 provides the driver compensation for distance the rider was billed for but the platform's trace records as driven. The fare_breakdown bills 20.00 km (distance_charged_km) while the trace records 22.40 km - a shortfall of 2.40 km, above the 1.0 km threshold - so the driver may be granted DRIVER_COMPENSATION at SGD 0.75 per unbilled kilometre: 2.40 x 0.75 = SGD 1.80, needing no rounding up and well inside the SGD 15.00 per-trip cap. Disclosure: the 22.40 km figure is carried by EV-GPS-00112, which is impaired at weight 0.4 with issue code CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT. The billed 20.00 km is the payments ledger's own figure on the clean EV-FARE-00112 (weight 1.0), whose admissibility note records that it is not a copy of trace_distance_km, so the two sides of the comparison come from independent artifacts and the finding survives the discount.

The rider's chat request for a stop at Paya Lebar Quarter is a rider instruction of the kind POL-RD-04 addresses - MSG-00112-001 carries a resolved waypoint_hint for venue VEN-PAYA-LEBAR-QUARTER and the driver answered 'ok can' - but the corroboration limb of POL-RD-04 cannot be run in the driver's favour on this record: the trace's own admissibility note records that the trace never comes near that waypoint, so the vehicle is not shown passing within 200 m of the resolved waypoint and the driver's account of having made the stop is not corroborated by the trace. I state that plainly rather than assert it. It changes nothing about the money: POL-RD-04 exonerates a driver from an excess, it does not pay a rider for a stop that was not made, and on either alignment reading of the excess the POL-RD-02 refund computes to zero. Disclosure: EV-GPS-00112 is impaired at weight 0.4 (CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT).

ruling.explanation:
Both of you: I cannot settle this one on the record, and I am sending it to a human reviewer with the file.

Why it cannot be settled. Your distance claim turns on where this trip actually began. The GPS trace runs 22.40 km (gps_trace.trace_distance_km) and, measured whole, shows an excess of 4.80 km over the 17.60 km optimal route — 27.3%, which would clear the POL-RD-01 gate. But the trip record says the trip (the meter) began at 18:32:10 (trip_record.started_at), while the trace's first fix is at 18:18:40 (gps_trace.first_fix_at) — 13 minutes 30 seconds earlier — and the fare (EV-FARE-00112) bills only 20.00 km (distance_charged_km). Measured from the recorded start, the excess is 2.42 km, 13.8%, which fails the same 20% gate. So whether the trace's opening 2.38 km belongs to this trip or is the tail of a previous job decides the deviation, and nothing in the bundle decides that question. If the meter started late the whole trace counts; if the trace carries a previous job the deviation disappears and the billed distance is right.

That is a ground the policy names for escalation. POL-RD-10(4) requires a human reviewer where pickup timestamps on two admitted artifacts disagree by more than ten minutes: the recorded trip start (18:32:10) and the trace's first fix (18:18:40) disagree by 13 minutes 30 seconds. The driver's account that the app was showing the trip as not started is an assertion citing no evidence, so it carries no weight under POL-RD-08, and in any event a contradiction the policy names as its own ground for escalation is not dissolved by an account from either side.

Confidence forces the same result independently. The facts that would decide this case are carried by the trip record and the GPS trace, both admitted at weight_multiplier 0.40 with issue CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT, and the 20% threshold straddles the two readings. Confidence is capped at 0.40, below the platform floor of 0.70, so POL-RD-10(1) applies too. The trace is NOT impaired for policy purposes — no gap over 90 seconds, no jump over 500 m, a 10-second sampling interval — so POL-RD-07(a)–(c) and POL-RD-10(3) are not engaged; the 0.40 is a POL-GEN-02 confidence discount only, and I am required to say both things.

Where the money would have fallen, so both of you can see it. (1) Even crediting the whole trace, POL-RD-02 recomputes the fare at 25.64: ((3.80 + 0.75 × 17.60 + 0.28 × 28.0) × the 1.0 surge read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier) + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 ERP/tolls, against a charged_total of 25.26 — so the refund would be 25.26 − 25.64 = −0.38, floored at zero and below the SGD 0.50 de minimis. The rider's distance claim would yield nothing on the arithmetic alone. (2) The missed Paya Lebar Quarter stop has no monetary remedy in this policy: POL-RD-04 exonerates a driver, it does not pay a rider, and the trace never comes within 200 m of the resolved waypoint (VEN-PAYA-LEBAR-QUARTER), so the driver's corroboration limb fails in any event. (3) The driver's own claim to SGD 1.80 (2.40 unbilled km × SGD 0.75, under the SGD 15.00 cap) rests on the same disputed opening stretch — the shortfall exists only if the trace's first 2.38 km is this trip — so it is held with everything else rather than paid. (4) No repeat-deviation pattern is established: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 1 against completed_trips_90d of 296 (ratio 0.0034), far below the POL-RD-06 gates, so there is no FULL_REFUND uplift and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral. (5) No closure defence arises: the LTA advisory artifact EV-ADVIS-00112-01 is MISSING, weight 0.00, so POL-RD-03 cannot be satisfied; and no POL-RD-09(4) billing-integrity finding arises, since erp_gantries is empty and there is no airport surcharge line. (6) No extra corroboration burden attaches to this rider (rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 1, below the 4-claim trigger in POL-RD-08).

Escalation is terminal: the contested SGD 6.00 is held, not collected and not refunded, and no money moves in either direction. What would resolve it: the platform's meter/dispatch log or the driver device log showing whether the meter started late or the trace carried the tail of a previous job, plus the platform's stored location pings for the Paya Lebar Quarter waypoint (whether the vehicle ever came within 200 m of it).

To both parties — the disputed SGD 6.00 is HELD for a human reviewer. No money moves today.

WHY THIS ESCALATES. The trip record (EV-TRIP-00112) and the GPS trace (EV-GPS-00112) disagree about when TRP-00112 began. The trip record's started_at is 18:32:10; the trace is already moving from its first fix at 18:18:40 — 13 minutes 30 seconds earlier — and covers 2.38 km before that start time. Both artifacts are impaired at weight 0.40 with issue code CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT, and the disagreement is over the 10-minute limb of POL-RD-10(4): where the pickup timestamps on two admitted artifacts disagree by more than 10 minutes, a final ruling must not issue and the case goes to a reviewer. The disagreement is not cosmetic. Measured over the whole trace the excess is 4.80 km / 27.3% and the POL-RD-01 threshold is crossed; measured from the trip record's start time only 20.02 km was driven and the excess is 2.42 km / 13.8% and it is NOT crossed. Nothing in the bundle settles which reading is right — the driver's explanation that the app was showing the trip as not started cites no evidence ID and carries no weight under POL-RD-08, and an account does not dissolve a ground the policy names for escalation.

The trace is otherwise clean for policy purposes: gaps is empty, max_gap_sec 0.00, coverage_pct 100.00, no 500 m jump and a steady 10 s sampling interval, so it is NOT impaired under POL-RD-07(a)-(c). Schema impairment and policy impairment are different tests and I say both out loud. But it is down-weighted to 0.40 under POL-GEN-02, and the measurement that would decide the money rests on those 0.40 artifacts, so any ruling on the money would be capped at 0.40 — below the 0.70 floor, a second and independent escalation trigger under POL-RD-10(1).

WHAT WOULD HAVE HAPPENED ON THE MONEY (so the stakes are clear). Taking the rider-favourable whole-trace figure of 22.40 km, the deviation IS established under POL-RD-01 (excess 4.80 km and 27.27%, both limbs passed). But POL-RD-02 recomputes the fare at 25.64 — (3.80 base + 0.75 x 17.60 km + 0.28 x 28.0 min) x the 1.0 surge read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 ERP + 0.00 waiting-time fee + 0.00 surcharge - 0.00 promo — against a charged_total of 25.26. Refund = 25.26 - 25.64 = -0.38, floored at zero and below the SGD 0.50 de minimis. So even on the rider's best reading, no refund would issue.

ON THE CLAIMS. Rider: your reading of POL-RD-01 is right — the trace figure governs and trip_record.actual_distance_km may not be cited for the threshold test — and your point that the opening stretch belongs to this trip (100% coverage, first fix 50 s after the trip record's own arrived_at of 18:17:50) is well taken; that is exactly why the conflict is material and must be escalated. Your refund nevertheless fails on the arithmetic above, and extra distance does not buy a separate payment for a stop. Your POL-RD-04 point is right: the trace never comes within 200 m of the resolved waypoint VEN-PAYA-LEBAR-QUARTER in MSG-00112-001, so the driver cannot shelter behind your request, and no part of the excess is rider-caused. Your POL-RD-03 point is right: the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00112-01 is MISSING (weight 0.00) and no closure exoneration arises. Your POL-RD-05, POL-RD-12 and POL-RD-11 points are also right (no relocation — both amendment fields null; not pooled — vehicle_type RYDE_X and solo_optimal_distance_km null; fare METERED with quoted_fare_sgd null). And rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d of 1 does not trigger the serial-claimant corroboration rule. Driver: your arithmetic (recomputed 25.64 vs charged 25.26) is correct and, had a ruling issued, would have produced no refund to the rider. Your POL-RD-06 point is correct: deviation_flags_90d of 1 against completed_trips_90d of 296 is far below the 3-flag and 0.05-ratio gates, so there is no FULL_REFUND uplift and no driver-conduct referral, and POL-GEN-01 permits only those two fields (prior_deviation_flags is a lifetime counter and may not be substituted). Your POL-RD-04 claim for SGD 1.80 (trace 22.40 km less billed 20.00 km = 2.40 km at SGD 0.75/km, inside the SGD 15.00 cap) is noted, but it depends on the same unresolved alignment and rests on the 0.40 trace, so it cannot be paid today.

Because escalation under POL-RD-10 is terminal, the SGD 6.00 in dispute is held — not collected and not refunded. To close this, a reviewer needs the platform-side record of when TRP-00112 actually began: a corrected started_at or meter-start log reconciling the 18:18:40 trace start with the 18:32:10 trip record, or confirmation that the 2.38 km before 18:32:10 belongs to a previous job.

This dispute goes to a human reviewer. No money moves on this record: the SGD 25.26 that was charged stands, and the SGD 6.00 in dispute is held rather than collected or refunded (POL-RD-10, POL-GEN-03). I cannot finally decide it, and here is why, for both parties.

WHAT IS UNDECIDED. The optimal route was 17.60 km (trip record; recounted on the fare breakdown). The platform's GPS trace (EV-GPS-00112) records 22.40 km, which is 4.80 km / 27.27% over — past both the 20% and the 0.8 km gates in POL-RD-01. But the trace and the trip record disagree about when the trip began: the trace's first fix is 18:18:40, the trip record's started_at is 18:32:10, a gap of 13 minutes 30 seconds — more than the 10-minute disagreement in POL-RD-10(4). Measured from the recorded start, only 20.02 km was driven: 2.42 km / 13.8% over, which fails the same gates. The admissibility report says in terms that nothing in the bundle decides whether the meter started late or the trace carries the tail of a previous job, and that the interpretation moves the measured excess across the POL-RD-01 threshold. I therefore cannot find a deviation established, and I cannot find it absent.

WHAT I DO ACCEPT. The driver's arithmetic is correct: POL-RD-02 recomputes the fare as ((3.80 base + 0.75 x 17.60 optimal km + 0.28 x 28.0 optimal min) x the 1.0 surge multiplier read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier) + 0.80 platform fee = 25.64, against the 25.26 charged, so the distance refund floors at zero and would be NO_ACTION as de minimis (0.50). I accept that. But the 17.60 km and 28.0 min that computation consumes are the trip record's figures, and the trip record is impaired; the 20.00 km / 13.6% figure relied on for the other reading is impaired on the same footing. A final ruling cannot issue on them at the confidence the policy requires.

WHY ESCALATION IS MANDATORY. Under POL-GEN-02(2) my confidence is capped by the LOWEST weight among the artifacts that carry the deciding fact. The facts that decide this case — the trip's measured distance and its start — are carried by EV-GPS-00112 and EV-TRIP-00112, both impaired by CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT at weight_multiplier 0.40, severity MAJOR. They are not independent of each other (POL-RD-01 itself calls the trip record's distance a rounded convenience copy of the same measurement), so the cap is 0.40, not the higher of the two. 0.40 is below the platform floor of 0.70, so POL-RD-10(1) fires, and the timestamp disagreement above is a second trigger under POL-RD-10(4). bundle_integrity_score is context for the reader only and is not the cap. POL-GEN-02(3) and POL-RD-07 also require me to say both things at once: the trace is schema-IMPAIRED at 0.40 for the CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT, but for POLICY purposes it is clean under POL-RD-07 — max_gap_sec 0.00, gaps empty, coverage 100%, sampling every 10 seconds — so it is NOT impaired under POL-RD-07(a)-(c), and the corroboration rule in POL-RD-07(iii) is not what decides this case.

THE CLAIMS, ANSWERED. Route deviation on the trace (rider, POL-RD-01): the 4.80 km / 27.27% figure is what the whole trace shows, but it depends on an alignment the bundle cannot resolve, so I neither find it nor dismiss it. Trip record's actual_distance_km may not be cited for the threshold (rider, POL-RD-01): accepted — the trace figure governs. No closure exoneration (POL-RD-03): accepted — EV-ADVIS-00112-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0, no LTA advisory covers the PIE/ECP window, so nothing is exonerated. Rider-requested detour (POL-RD-04): the chat log (EV-CHAT-00112, weight 1.00) shows the rider asked to pass Paya Lebar Quarter and the driver answered 'ok can', but POL-RD-04 requires the trace to corroborate by passing within 200 m of the resolved waypoint (VEN-PAYA-LEBAR-QUARTER), and the trace never approaches it — exoneration is unavailable to the driver, and POL-RD-04 equally pays no rider remedy for a stop not made. The driver's account of making the stop and waiting four minutes cites no evidence ID and is contradicted by the trace, so it carries no corroborative weight (POL-RD-08); I do not treat it as the second side of a POL-RD-10(7) conflict, because there is no admissible evidence on the driver's side of it. Driver compensation for unbilled distance (POL-RD-04): 22.40 - 20.00 = 2.40 km x 0.75 = 1.80 would be due only if the whole 22.40 km belongs to this trip — it rests on the impaired trace and on the same undecidable alignment, and if the opening 2.38 km is a previous job the shortfall is 0.02 km and nothing is due; not granted on this record. POL-RD-05 relocation: accepted, both amended-optimal fields are null, clause does not engage. POL-RD-12 pooled trip: accepted, vehicle_type is RYDE_X and solo_optimal_distance_km is null, so 17.60 km remains the baseline. POL-RD-11 upfront fare: accepted, fare_model is METERED and quoted_fare_sgd is null, so that clause does not apply and POL-RD-02 is the operative remedy clause. POL-RD-06 repeat pattern: accepted that no pattern is established — deviation_flags_90d is 1 and completed_trips_90d is 296, a ratio of 0.0034 — so there is no FULL_REFUND uplift and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral; prior_deviation_flags is a lifetime counter and a context-only profile field (POL-GEN-01). POL-RD-08 serial-claimant corroboration: accepted, deviation_claims_60d is 1, far below 4, so no extra burden attaches. POL-GEN-03: accepted — ESCALATE is terminal and the amount is held.

WHAT WOULD RESOLVE IT. An independent measurement of this trip's true start and distance: a trace re-aligned to the recorded pickup event, the platform's own distance derived independently of this trace, or any record showing whether the opening 2.38 km belongs to this trip or the previous job. Any of those would lift the 0.40 cap and let the POL-RD-02 arithmetic be run finally. The reviewer should also note the missing LTA advisory (EV-ADVIS-00112-01).

To the rider and the driver: I cannot decide this case on the present record, so it goes to a human reviewer and no money moves. The SGD 6.00 contested amount and the SGD 25.26 charged on EV-FARE-00112 are held — not refunded to the rider, not collected from her, and no payment to the driver — until a reviewer resolves the one fact the bundle cannot decide.

What is undecided. The trip record (EV-TRIP-00112) says this trip began at 18:32:10; the trace (EV-GPS-00112) begins at 18:18:40 and has the vehicle moving 2.38 km before that start. Read over the whole trace the distance is 22.40 km against the 17.60 km optimal, an excess of 4.80 km or 27.27%, which clears both POL-RD-01 limbs; read from the recorded start only 20.02 km was driven, an excess of 2.42 km or 13.8%, which fails the 20% limb. The interpretation also decides the driver's unbilled-distance claim: on the whole-trace reading the fare bills 20.00 km against 22.40 km (a 2.40 km shortfall worth 2.40 x 0.75 = SGD 1.80); on the recorded-window reading there is no shortfall at all. Nothing in the bundle decides which is right.

The triggers that fire (POL-RD-10). (1) My confidence cannot reach the 0.70 floor. POL-GEN-02(2) caps confidence at the MINIMUM weight of the artifacts carrying the deciding facts; the trace and the trip record are each down-weighted to 0.40 with issue CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT, and there is no second independent carrier — POL-RD-01 makes the trace the governing field and forbids substituting trip_record.actual_distance_km for the threshold test, and the optimal distance and duration the fare arithmetic consumes are stored on the same impaired trip record. The cap is 0.40. (4) The trip record's start (18:32:10) and the trace's first fix (18:18:40) disagree by 13 minutes 30 seconds, over the 10-minute limb. (7) The chat log (EV-CHAT-00112) records the rider's request to stop at Paya Lebar Quarter with a platform-resolved waypoint (MSG-00112-001, VEN-PAYA-LEBAR-QUARTER) and the driver's 'ok can'; the driver's counterparty statement says he made that stop; the trace never approaches the waypoint. That is the clause's own example of admissible, mutually contradictory evidence of comparable strength. (3) does NOT fire: the trace has no gap over 90 s (gaps empty, max_gap_sec 0.0), no jump over 500 m, and a 10-second sampling interval over 203 fixes with 100% coverage.

What is impaired and what that means. As POL-GEN-02(3) requires me to state: EV-GPS-00112 and EV-TRIP-00112 are schema-IMPAIRED at weight 0.40 with issue CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT (severity MAJOR), and I have discounted them accordingly. But the trace is policy-CLEAN under POL-RD-07(a)-(c). Both things are true at once, and the trace is discounted, not erased. POL-RD-06 requires driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d of 3 or more, or a ratio of deviation_flags_90d to completed_trips_90d of 0.05 or more with completed_trips_90d of at least 40. This driver's profile shows deviation_flags_90d of 1 and completed_trips_90d of 296 - one flag, and a ratio of 0.0034, far below both gates. Under POL-GEN-01 those two fields are the only profile fields POL-RD-06 permits for this test, and no other field on the driver profile may ground a finding; the lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags is not the trailing-90-day figure POL-RD-06 names and cannot be substituted for it.

ledger.claim: The governing measurement establishes the deviation. gps_trace.trace_distance_km is 22.40 km against an optimal of 17.60 km, an excess of 4.80 km or 27.27%, which clears both limbs of the POL-RD-01 test (greater than 20% of optimal AND greater than 0.8 km). I cite the trace with its impairment disclosed: weight_multiplier 0.40, issue CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT, flagged MAJOR; the trip record is impaired on the same footing (0.40, CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT).

POL-RD-01 makes the trace figure the governing one and says in terms that trip_record.actual_distance_km 'may NOT be cited for the threshold test'. The 20.00 km / 13.6% deviation_pct carried on the trip record therefore cannot be used to defeat this claim; the trace governs by the clause's own words. Both artifacts cited here are impaired at weight 0.40 with issue CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT.

The trace's opening stretch belongs to this trip and not to a previous job. coverage_pct is 100.00, gaps is empty and max_gap_sec is 0.00, and first_fix_at 18:18:40 falls 50 seconds after the driver's own recorded arrival at the pickup (arrived_at 18:17:50) and well after his accepted_at of 18:15:10. The polyline between the recorded pickup event and the recorded dropoff event is therefore the full 22.40 km. The trace is impaired at weight 0.40 (CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT) and the trip record likewise (0.40, CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT).

No road-closure exoneration is available to the driver. The traffic advisory artifact is MISSING — no LTA advisory covers the PIE or the ECP in the 18:14-18:52 window on 4 August 2026 — and it therefore carries weight 0.00 with issue MISSING_ARTIFACT. Its absence is itself citable, and on a record with no advisory POL-RD-03 cannot be satisfied on any of its three limbs.

The driver cannot shelter behind the rider's chat request. POL-RD-04 exonerates only to the extent the gps_trace corroborates the instruction by passing within 200 m of chat_message.waypoint_hint — here the platform-resolved VEN-PAYA-LEBAR-QUARTER in MSG-00112-001. The record of the trace, as the chat log's own admissibility assessment states, is that it never comes near that waypoint, so the corroboration limb fails and no part of the 4.80 km excess is attributable to a rider instruction. The trace cited is impaired at weight 0.40 with issue CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT.

The driver's account of the PLQ stop is a bare assertion with nothing behind it. His counterparty statement claims he made the stop and waited about four minutes, but it cites no evidence ID and it is contradicted by the trace, which never approaches the requested waypoint. Under POL-RD-08 an assertion from either side that cites no evidence ID carries no weight and is discarded, and the same applies to his uncited explanation that the app was showing the trip as not started. EV-GPS-00112 is impaired at 0.40, issue CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT.

No relocation defence is open. pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are both null on the trip record, so POL-RD-05's amended re-quote cannot be run and there is no amended optimal to absorb the excess; POL-RD-05 simply does not engage. The trip record cited is impaired at weight 0.40 with issue CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT.

This is not a pooled trip. vehicle_type is RYDE_X and solo_optimal_distance_km is null, so POL-RD-12's matched-itinerary baseline is unavailable and 17.60 km remains the correct baseline for the POL-RD-01 test. The trip record cited is impaired at weight 0.40 with issue CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT.

The fare is metered, so the distance-and-time route is not closed. fare_breakdown.fare_model is METERED and quoted_fare_sgd is null, so POL-RD-11's upfront bar does not apply and POL-RD-02 remains the operative remedy clause. payment_status is CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd is 0.00, so the rider has had nothing returned and the full charged total of SGD 25.26 stands against her.

Confidence in this case cannot reach the 0.70 floor. The fact that decides it — the measured excess — is carried solely by the gps_trace, at weight_multiplier 0.40 (issue CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT), because POL-RD-01 forbids substituting trip_record.actual_distance_km (also 0.40, CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT) for the threshold test. Under POL-GEN-02(2) confidence must not exceed the minimum weight of the artifacts carrying the deciding fact, and with no second independent carrier that cap is 0.40. POL-RD-10(1) therefore requires escalation.

Two admitted artifacts disagree about when this trip began by 13 minutes 30 seconds: trip_record.started_at is 18:32:10 while the trace's first_fix_at is 18:18:40. That is over the 10-minute limb of POL-RD-10(4), and the pre-pass records it as a MAJOR CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT whose resolution moves the measured excess across the POL-RD-01 threshold. Both artifacts are impaired at weight 0.40 with issue CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT.

The two sides rest on admissible and mutually contradictory evidence, which is exactly the situation POL-RD-10(7) names — 'a chat_log detour request whose waypoint the gps_trace never approaches'. The chat log is COMPLETE at weight 1.00 and records the rider asking for a stop at a resolved waypoint and the driver answering 'ok can'; the driver asserts the stop was made; the trace never approaches the waypoint. Nothing in the bundle decides whether the stop happened, and that is not a finding for the driver. The trace cited is impaired at 0.40, issue CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT.

Escalation is the disposition that protects the rider on this record. Under POL-GEN-03, ESCALATE is terminal, replaces the ruling, and the disputed amount is held rather than collected or refunded, and it never means 'restore the charge'; NO_ACTION, by contrast, is party-relative and on a rider-filed dispute leaves the SGD 25.26 charged total and the SGD 0.00 refund_issued_sgd exactly as they are. The contested SGD 6.00 should be held for a human reviewer rather than left standing.

No extra corroboration burden attaches to this rider. rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 1, far below the 4-claim trigger in POL-RD-08, so the additional-corroboration condition for serial claimants does not fire and the claim is judged on the ordinary burden. POL-GEN-01 confines that profile field to the test POL-RD-08 names and to nothing else.

The arithmetic decides this case, and it decides it for the driver. On the platform's own governing trace figure of 22.40 km, POL-RD-02 recomputes the fare as (3.80 base + 0.75 x 17.6 optimal km + 0.28 x 28.0 optimal min) x the surge multiplier of 1.0 read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, plus the 0.80 platform fee, plus 0.00 ERP/tolls (erp_gantries is empty and tolls_erp is 0.00), plus 0.00 fixed surcharge, plus 0.00 waiting-time fee, less 0.00 promo = 25.64. The charged_total is 25.26. Refund = 25.26 - 25.64 = -0.38, floored at zero, and a zero refund falls below the SGD 0.50 de minimis. So even if a deviation were established, no money moves and the outcome is NO_ACTION with the present charge standing. The trip is METERED and quoted_fare_sgd is null, so POL-RD-11 does not run and no POL-RD-09 pass-through correction is available either. Disclosure: EV-TRIP-00112 is impaired at weight 0.4 with issue code CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT, but that conflict goes to when the trip began, not to the stored booking quote for optimal distance and duration that this arithmetic consumes; the fare_breakdown itself is clean at weight 1.0, and the finding survives the discount because the deciding figures are the fare_breakdown's own.

The POL-RD-01 threshold is not crossed on the record's own alignment of this trip, and the excess is in any event not material. POL-RD-01 measures the actual distance between the recorded pickup event and the recorded dropoff event, and the governing field is gps_trace.trace_distance_km: read from those two recorded events, the trace covers 20.02 km against an optimal of 17.60 km, an excess of 2.42 km or 13.8%, which fails the greater-than-20% limb of the establishment test; no deviation exists and the outcome is NO_ACTION however the rider characterises the trip. Even on the widest reading, the whole-trace excess is 4.80 km and 27.3%, below both the 50% and the 8.0 km materiality gates, so this is not a MATERIAL deviation and the POL-RD-06 driver_profile check is not engaged. The same conflict defeats the rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08(a) and (b), which require a matching pickup timestamp across trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown and an excess measured from an unimpaired trace; here the trace begins at 18:18:40 while the trip record says the trip began at 18:32:10. Disclosure: EV-GPS-00112 and EV-TRIP-00112 both carry CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT at weight 0.4 (severity MAJOR); I disclose it rather than present either as clean, and the finding does not need either of them to be credited at full weight, because the refund is zero on the whole-trace reading too.

No repeat-deviation pattern is established, so neither the FULL_REFUND uplift nor the driver-conduct referral under POL-RD-06 is available to the rider. POL-RD-06 requires driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d of 3 or more, or a ratio of deviation_flags_90d to completed_trips_90d of 0.05 or more with completed_trips_90d of at least 40. This driver's profile shows deviation_flags_90d of 1 and completed_trips_90d of 296 - one flag, and a ratio of 0.0034, far below both gates. Under POL-GEN-01 those two fields are the only profile fields POL-RD-06 permits for this test, and no other field on the driver profile may ground a finding; the lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags is not the trailing-90-day figure POL-RD-06 names and cannot be substituted for it.

ledger.claim: Separately from the exoneration limb, POL-RD-04 provides the driver compensation for distance the rider was billed for but the platform's trace records as driven. The fare_breakdown bills 20.00 km (distance_charged_km) while the trace records 22.40 km - a shortfall of 2.40 km, above the 1.0 km threshold - so the driver may be granted DRIVER_COMPENSATION at SGD 0.75 per unbilled kilometre: 2.40 x 0.75 = SGD 1.80, needing no rounding up and well inside the SGD 15.00 per-trip cap. Disclosure: the 22.40 km figure is carried by EV-GPS-00112, which is impaired at weight 0.4 with issue code CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT. The billed 20.00 km is the payments ledger's own figure on the clean EV-FARE-00112 (weight 1.0), whose admissibility note records that it is not a copy of trace_distance_km, so the two sides of the comparison come from independent artifacts and the finding survives the discount.

The rider's chat request for a stop at Paya Lebar Quarter is a rider instruction of the kind POL-RD-04 addresses - MSG-00112-001 carries a resolved waypoint_hint for venue VEN-PAYA-LEBAR-QUARTER and the driver answered 'ok can' - but the corroboration limb of POL-RD-04 cannot be run in the driver's favour on this record: the trace's own admissibility note records that the trace never comes near that waypoint, so the vehicle is not shown passing within 200 m of the resolved waypoint and the driver's account of having made the stop is not corroborated by the trace. I state that plainly rather than assert it. It changes nothing about the money: POL-RD-04 exonerates a driver from an excess, it does not pay a rider for a stop that was not made, and on either alignment reading of the excess the POL-RD-02 refund computes to zero. Disclosure: EV-GPS-00112 is impaired at weight 0.4 (CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT).
